title: Hyperlex Lineage Attachment v1
description: Optional lineage metadata attached to analysis results. Documents which historical slang family a signal belongs to and how the current terms relate to it.

family_id.description: Canonical identifier for the documented family (e.g. betting-sharp, crypto-degen, ai-native)

matched_terms.description: Terms from the current signal that matched this family

branch_operator.description: Primary mutation operator that produced or is producing the current leaf

confidence.description: Matcher confidence that the signal belongs to this family

diagram_ref.description: Relative path to the Mermaid or HTML diagram for this family

payload_note.description: Short note on the stable semantic/identity payload still carried
